CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to content organization was asserted.

COD.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (red at coordinates) and provides a separate origin/status field for the same referent, and a presented coordinate listing (organization) for that content.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content organization/emergence/access.
